review.notes: Independent source-evidence re-review verified 3 frozen Git blobs and exact SHA-256 values at 219fe4a1e9fe00783d4b14cc2dde879c08d27cc9. Independent review confirms the root lock hash and the src/assets gitlink, but the tree has no engines, packageManager, runtime file, or CI toolchain. Node 22.19.0/npm 10.9.3 therefore remains an unauthenticated fallback, and git submodule status only inspects an already-materialized submodule. Exact Linux x64 install and submodule validation are required before approval.

sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen tree binds src/assets as a git submodule, so preparation may only verify materialization without undeclared network access.
Frozen root npm lockfile is bound for deterministic npm ci preparation.
Manifest defines the Angular build but provides no engines or exact npm packageManager pin.
